# Android launch gap report: Syrian Zone app vs https://syrian.zone

Scope: 15 audited sections. Findings refuted by the verifier are dropped. Items the verifier did not check are tagged `[unverified]`.

## 1. Launch blockers

- all sections: the entire `/api/mobile/*` surface (68 routes) is absent from `main`, the only branch `deploy.yml` ships, so every mobile-API-backed screen 404s on production until the backend merges and deploys (mobile: mobile/src/lib/api/client.ts:142; website: routes/api.php:144).
- dashboard+auth: sign-in opens `https://syrian.zone/api/mobile/auth/google`, gets Laravel's 404 page, and closing it is classified as a user cancel, so no error is ever shown and every account-gated screen is unreachable (mobile: mobile/src/lib/auth/browser.ts:71,108; website: routes/web.php:215).
- dashboard: every dashboard tab reads `/api/mobile/account*`, so profile, avatar, deletion, drafts and the poll tab all fail even with a valid token (mobile: mobile/src/features/Dashboard/api.ts:47; website: routes/web.php:221).
- admin-screens: poll/candidate/group/upload administration lives entirely on undeployed `/api/mobile/admin/*` with no fallback to the live legacy poll routes (mobile: mobile/src/components/admin/api.ts:69; website: routes/web.php:244).
- transit: the route detail screen calls `/api/mobile/transit/...` only and never falls back to bundled `_data`, so every route shows "تعذر العثور على الخط." (mobile: mobile/src/features/Transit/_lib/api.ts:236; website: resources/js/Pages/Transit/city/[id]/route/[routeId]/Index.tsx).
- transit: this branch widens the CSRF exemption to `api/v1/studio/routes/*` against the explicit warning kept on main, a website-side security regression that must be reverted before merge (mobile: n/a; website: bootstrap/app.php:47).
- population: the atlas loads boundaries + master + env-report in one query whose zod `.strict()` schemas fail against the live production payloads today, blanking the map and all five tabs (mobile: mobile/src/features/Population/lib/schemas.ts:53,147; website: routes/web.php:81).
- places-mishwar: production serves the Places write paths as session+CSRF web routes, so the app's bearer `POST /api/v1/places` returns 419 "CSRF token mismatch" even with a token (mobile: mobile/src/features/Places/_lib/api.ts:292; website: routes/web.php:190).
- syid: the flag-proportions image is referenced by a hardcoded Arabic filename that 404s on production, so the image and all three download buttons in that card fail today (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:216; website: resources/js/Pages/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:275).
- dashboard+about: the app bundles Streamline-derived icons but ships a stale about copy with no CC BY 4.0 attribution, which the live About page carries (mobile: mobile/src/data/about.ts:1; website: resources/js/Pages/About.tsx:186).

## 2. User-visible gaps

- compass: the result gauge lays pole labels out physically LTR while positioning the marker with `left:%`, so the marker sits under the wrong pole and the numeric "نسبة X%" readout is dropped (mobile: mobile/src/features/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:147; website: resources/js/Pages/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:284).
- guesswho: a mobile client joining a website-created room drops every web signal (generation 0) and, as player_2, never offers, so cross-platform rooms hang forever (mobile: mobile/src/features/GuessWho/presence.ts:48; website: app/Http/Controllers/SignalingController.php:19).
- guesswho: ICE comes from the server, which ships STUN-only because `turn_urls`/`turn_secret` are unset everywhere, while the website hardcodes Open Relay TURN, so CGNAT players fail to connect (mobile: mobile/src/features/GuessWho/useGuessWhoRoom.ts:264; website: resources/js/Pages/GuessWho/Room.tsx:355).
- guesswho: no way to resume an in-progress room from the lobby, and the room code is a 36-char UUID shown only as the room title (mobile: mobile/src/features/GuessWho/Index.tsx:118; website: routes/web.php:85).
- guesswho: room sharing emits `syrianzone://feature/guesswho?room=` instead of the canonical https room URL (mobile: mobile/src/features/GuessWho/Room.tsx:234; website: routes/web.php:85).
- board: a guest board is abandoned on sign-in because storage is account-scoped and sync uploads a fresh default document, where the website promotes the guest board (mobile: mobile/src/features/Board/Index.tsx:63; website: resources/js/Pages/Board/_lib/sync.ts:89).
- board: number config fields clamp on every keystroke, so clearing pomodoro work minutes rewrites the field to "5" and 10/15 are untypable in the 3-20 answers limit (mobile: mobile/src/features/Board/Index.tsx:804; website: resources/js/Pages/Board/_components/WidgetConfigDialog.tsx:74).
- board: the weather widget prints the raw upstream English condition and ISO dates instead of the Arabic condition and weekday labels (mobile: mobile/src/features/Board/WidgetRenderer.tsx:228; website: resources/js/Pages/Board/_widgets/weather/View.tsx:69).
- priorities: the 100-point budget has only +1/-1 steppers and no slider, so a full allocation is 100 taps and gates every export (mobile: mobile/src/features/Priorities/PrioritiesApp.tsx:225; website: resources/js/Pages/Priorities/PrioritiesApp.tsx:955).
- priorities: the persona is reduced to a bare title with no icon, tag, description or "بانتظار توزيع النقاط" placeholder (mobile: mobile/src/features/Priorities/model.ts:107; website: resources/js/Pages/Priorities/PrioritiesApp.tsx:386).
- compass: answer buttons render only -2..+2 numerals with no أعارض بشدة/محايد/أوافق بشدة legend (mobile: mobile/src/features/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:80; website: resources/js/Pages/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:195).
- compass: no image export of the result card, despite react-native-view-shot already shipping and being used by Alignment and Priorities (mobile: mobile/src/features/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:154; website: resources/js/Pages/Compass/CompassApp.tsx:116).
- polls: a candidate placed in a tier can never be returned to the bank; the only escape is a full board reset (mobile: mobile/src/components/poll/TierBoard.tsx:371; website: resources/js/Components/poll/TierBoard.tsx:534).
- polls: poll selection and leaderboard live in component state on one `/feature/polls` route, so Android back exits the feature and no poll is deep-linkable (mobile: mobile/src/features/Polls/Index.tsx:15; website: routes/web.php:44).
- places-mishwar: the map is a fixed 420px box inside a pull-to-refresh ScrollView rather than the website's full-viewport map with a docked list (mobile: mobile/src/features/Places/_components/PlacesMap.tsx:286; website: resources/js/Pages/Places/Index.tsx:244).
- admin-screens: the SyOfficial, Phonebook and GovApps admin lists render every row flat with no search, category filter or counters (154/95/28 rows) while `DirectorySearchField` sits unused in the same barrel (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyOfficial/Admin/Index.tsx:612, Phonebook/Admin/Index.tsx:564, GovApps/Admin/Index.tsx:354; website: resources/js/Pages/Admin/Phonebook/Index.tsx:204).
- admin-screens: SyOfficial reordering operates on the global category-mixed list, so up/down presses swap across categories and are no-ops in the default grouped public view (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyOfficial/Admin/Index.tsx:640; website: resources/js/Pages/Admin/SyOfficial/Index.tsx:367).
- admin-screens: `managedUserSchema` allows only 4 roles, so one `syofficial_admin`/`govapps_admin`/`phonebook_admin` account makes the whole list parse fail with a 502 `invalid_response` (mobile: mobile/src/features/Admin/usersApi.ts:7; website: app/Filament/Resources/UserResource.php:38).
- admin-screens: the app can create only user/admin/transit_admin and cannot change role, granular permissions or password on an existing account (mobile: mobile/src/features/Admin/usersModel.ts:7; website: app/Filament/Resources/UserResource.php:38).
- admin-screens: the superadmin R2 asset manager has no native counterpart and neither the page nor the controller exists on this branch (mobile: mobile/src/app/admin/; website: routes/web.php:183).
- dashboard+about: About renders a byte-identical copy of the retired `resources/js/Data/about.md`, losing the EN tab and contributor @abd_hmh while re-adding sections the website dropped (mobile: mobile/src/data/about.ts:1; website: resources/js/Pages/About.tsx:31).
- syid: the flag-proportions diagram is replaced by a plain unannotated PNG plus one sentence, dropping every measurement callout including star spacing (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:209; website: resources/js/Pages/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:275).
- syid: the copy/download toast is an inline card at the bottom of a very long ScrollView instead of a fixed overlay, so download errors are never seen (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:370; website: resources/js/Pages/SyId/SyidClient.tsx:535).
- android-platform: no crash reporting and no ErrorBoundary anywhere, so a release render crash yields a blank screen or a native "keeps stopping" and nobody is notified (mobile: mobile/src/app/_layout.tsx:38; website: resources/js/app.tsx:17).
- transit: map has no route tap/selection, no stop popups, user-location layer never mounts, and stop search results are dead taps (mobile: mobile/src/features/Transit/_components/citymap/RouteLayer.tsx, StopsLayer.tsx, MapCanvas.tsx:45, GlobalSearchBox.tsx:41; website: resources/js/Pages/Transit/_components/citymap/).
- transit: studio has no drag-to-reposition, no conflict-warning dismiss, no toasts, no reset, and no auth gate before submit so guests can post anonymous drafts (mobile: mobile/src/features/Transit/studio/; website: resources/js/Pages/Transit/studio/).
- transit: route colorIndex misses the modulo-8 wrap and nearby radius is 750m vs the website's 500m (mobile: mobile/src/features/Transit/_components/citymap/RouteLayer.tsx:8; website: resources/js/Pages/Transit/_components/citymap/RouteLayer.tsx).
- transit: city page lacks the city-not-found guard and the routeCount subtitle (mobile: mobile/src/features/Transit/city/[id]/Index.tsx; website: resources/js/Pages/Transit/city/[id]/Index.tsx).

## 3. Polish

- cross-cutting i18n/RTL: ~131 hardcoded `flexDirection:'row-reverse'` sites across 53 files and Arabic-only copy on 40+ screens, so English/LTR mode mixes left-aligned English chrome with mirrored Arabic content (mobile: mobile/src/features/Dashboard/Index.tsx:737, House/HouseClient.tsx:596, Polls/Leaderboard.tsx:287, Population/PopulationClient.tsx:239; website: resources/js/app.tsx:55). `[partly unverified]`
- cross-cutting deep links: `app.config.ts` declares only the `syrianzone` scheme, no Android intentFilters and no iOS associatedDomains, so no shared syrian.zone URL opens the app (mobile: mobile/app.config.ts:13; website: routes/web.php:76). `[unverified]`
- cross-cutting dead code: `sort` options are accepted then ignored in SyOfficial, Sites and Party, with a vacuous test asserting only length (mobile: mobile/src/features/Sites/data.ts:54; website: n/a). `[unverified]`
- polls: the chart capture surface is hardcoded `#ffffff` while the title uses the theme foreground, so it is white-on-white in every dark theme (mobile: mobile/src/features/Polls/TimeseriesChart.tsx:219; website: resources/js/Pages/Polls/TimeseriesChart.tsx:273).
- polls: the Justice list has no empty state and drops the "من رموز النظام" count line (mobile: mobile/src/features/Justice/Index.tsx:113; website: resources/js/Pages/Justice/Index.tsx:152).
- house: records are hard-paginated at 40 with prev/next only (1,591 rows = 40 pages) where the website scrolls one table (mobile: mobile/src/features/House/HouseClient.tsx:53; website: resources/js/Pages/House/HouseClient.tsx:497).
- house: the winners district picker is a 47-chip horizontal strip with no search or jump, replacing a native `<select>` (mobile: mobile/src/features/House/HouseClient.tsx:310; website: resources/js/Pages/House/HouseClient.tsx:287).
- syofficial: admin list has no search or category filter across 154 entities (mobile: mobile/src/features/SyOfficial/Admin/Index.tsx:612; website: resources/js/Pages/Admin/SyOfficial/Index.tsx:44).
- phonebook+govapps: govapps admin has no search field and no total count (mobile: mobile/src/features/GovApps/Admin/Index.tsx:354; website: resources/js/Pages/Admin/GovApps/Index.tsx:37).

## 6. Cannot be done in the app

- Per-page SEO metadata, `<Head>` titles/descriptions and Open Graph link previews for every ported page; anything shared out of the app is a syrian.zone URL rendered by Laravel/Inertia.
- Shareable, bookmarkable, copy-pasteable URL state: `?place=`, `?guide=`, `?view=`, `?edit={id}`, `#colors`/`#map` fragments, `/polls/{slug}/leaderboard`, `/guesswho/room/{code}`; the app can only approximate with `syrianzone://` routes.
- Hover-only affordances everywhere: `title` tooltips, map hover tooltips with rainfall mini-charts, per-platform social hover colors, row hover highlight, card hover lift, hover-revealed download buttons.
- Direct-to-Downloads saving via `<a download>` (Compass JPG, Alignment PNG/SVG, Priorities story PNG, tier-list.png, jolani-images.zip, chart PNG, BrandKit.zip, Arabic-named SyId files); native can only hand bytes to the OS share sheet.
- Desktop information density: 4-6 column data tables with sticky headers (Phonebook, Sites, Party, SyOfficial, House), `lg:grid-cols-5/7` grids, the desktop side panel plus 4-column masonry.
- Keyboard interaction: dnd-kit keyboard sensors, HTML5 drag-and-drop of tier candidates, arrow/Enter/Escape combobox navigation, Escape to cancel pin-drop, browser find-in-page and free text selection/print.
- Service-worker offline shell (`public/sw.js` caches every same-origin GET), PWA install / add-to-home-screen, and the separate Transit web manifest.
- The Filament `/superadmin` panel (server-rendered Livewire user CRUD, permission matrix, GuessWho resources); the app can only open it in an external browser with no session.
- Session+CSRF web endpoints as deployed (`/api/account/*`, `/logout`, `/api/v1/admin/places`, poll/candidate routes) cannot be driven by a bearer client; Google OAuth must leave the app for a system browser.
- Sentry same-origin distributed tracing, the `/ingest` PostHog anti-adblock proxy, bfcache restore, the Inertia progress bar, and cookie-session dev impersonation.
- Live theme mirroring: `MutationObserver` on `data-theme` and mid-session `map.setStyle`; the native basemap is fixed to the bundled JSON.
- Zero-latency first paint from server-rendered Inertia props backed by a 10-minute server cache; a native screen always makes a cold-start round-trip.
- Opening any website path with no native screen: expo-router only routes the 21 files under `mobile/src/app`.

## 7. Verdict

Nothing else matters until the mobile backend merges and deploys: the app is built from this branch and pinned to `https://syrian.zone`, so today's APK cannot sign in and roughly half its screens render only an error card. After that ships, four defects are genuine ship-stoppers on their own: the Population atlas fails its strict zod schemas against the live payloads, the Compass gauge puts the result marker under the wrong pole label, the SyId flag-proportions asset 404s and takes three download buttons with it, and the Transit CSRF exemption widening must be reverted before it reaches the website. Add crash reporting and a root ErrorBoundary before any store submission, since a release crash currently produces a blank screen with no signal, and restore the CC BY 4.0 attribution for the bundled Streamline-derived icons. The next tier, worth fixing but not blocking, is the admin usability cluster (no search or filter across three directory admins, category-mixed SyOfficial reordering, the role-enum 502 that blanks the users list) and the Guess Who web-to-mobile signaling mismatch plus missing TURN, which make cross-platform play look broken rather than degraded. The pervasive hardcoded `row-reverse` and Arabic-only copy is a deliberate house convention, not a launch gap: either drop the English locale from Settings or scope it honestly, but do not treat it as 131 bugs.
